repos.name: mikehasa/agentacct
repos.description: See what your coding agents did and what it cost. Breaks each task down into work steps — tools used, files changed, tests run, time and tokens spent. Local-first dashboard for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and more. No login, no telemetry.
repos.one_liner: A local-first observability and cost-tracking dashboard for AI coding agents.
bullets: Built with Python, providing a local-first dashboard to monitor agent activity.
Tracks granular metrics including time spent, token usage, file modifications, and tool execution.
Integrates with popular coding agents like Claude Code and Codex to provide transparency into development costs.
Enables developers to audit agent performance and optimize workflows by analyzing specific work steps.
repos.img_alt: agentacct tui — live usage, cost, provider rate-limit bars, and recent sessions with per-session weekly-plan-cost estimates
repos.img2_alt: agentacct tui session detail — the per-step work ledger with pass/fail check evidence and a weekly-plan-cost estimate

repos.name: simonlin1212/vibe-astock
repos.description: A 股短线复盘看板：涨停池·连板梯队·龙虎榜·板块资金一屏看完，赚钱效应/晋级率/梯队断层/情绪周期等派生指标纯计算直出（不经过 AI），AI 只把数据串成能读的盘面研判。全本地运行，可用 Claude/Codex 订阅免 API key。| A-share short-term daily-review dashboard: derived sentiment metrics computed locally, AI only writes the narrative. No API key needed.
repos.one_liner: A local-first A-share market dashboard providing sentiment analysis and technical indicators.
bullets: Uses a hybrid approach: pure mathematical computation for market metrics and AI for narrative synthesis.
Features include limit-up pools, sentiment cycles, and capital flow tracking for A-share short-term trading.
Operates entirely locally, supporting integration with Claude/Codex for automated market commentary.
Designed for quantitative traders who need real-time, data-driven insights without relying on external API-heavy platforms.

repos.name: EthanXiang777/circuit-framework
repos.description: Circuit Framework — multi-agent LLM trading research system
repos.one_liner: A multi-agent LLM framework specifically designed for trading research and strategy development.
bullets: Python-based architecture designed to orchestrate multiple LLM agents for financial research tasks.
Provides a structured environment for testing trading hypotheses using agentic workflows.
Focuses on the intersection of LLM reasoning and quantitative finance research.
Useful for researchers looking to automate the generation and validation of trading strategies through multi-agent collaboration.
